verdict.rationale: Orrick runs client-facing tools (Tech Studio forms, Orrick Connect portals), so asking whether user data is kept out of AI training is a fair question. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment. The ISO 27001 certification and the GenAI Policy Builder, which helps companies draft their own employee AI-use policies, are adjacent features and do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
